headline: Earthstone Holding (Two) Private Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers
sum: Earthstone Holding (Two) Private Limited has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material shareholding trigger in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The disclosure marks formal notice of acquisition crossing a regulatory threshold, requiring public filing with NSE.
detail: Earthstone Holding (Two) Private Limited has triggered SEBI's mandatory disclosure requirement under Regulation 31(4) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, following what appears to be a substantial shareholding acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The disclosure was submitted to NSE. No further details regarding acquisition percentage, consideration, or transaction conditions were disclosed in the available filing extract.
